title: Feedback Form
prompt:
Process a POST form, validate fields on the server, show actionable errors, and use Post/Redirect/Get on success.

Use synthetic data and a local/test environment only. Submit: a small ASP/VBScript/configuration artifact or a reviewable text design, written expected behavior, one negative/boundary case, and a short note about runtime/provider assumptions.

Syllabus mapping: topics 54–56.
target_skills: Validate one normal case and one negative/boundary case

expected_output: A reviewable artifact for Feedback Form that meets the acceptance criteria and documents expected/observed behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Includes a normal case and an invalid/boundary case with expected behavior.
Performs required validation and follows the relevant security/resource-handling rule.
Documents IIS/runtime/provider assumptions and the observed result; does not claim unrun tests.
hints: Start with lesson 56: Form Processing Patterns.
Keep the first example small and use a fixed/synthetic input.
Write the expected result first; then add a failure case and record evidence.
grading_method: Required-string completeness smoke check plus human review of Classic ASP/VBScript/IIS/provider correctness, security, acceptance criteria, failure handling, and reproducibility. This does not execute ASP code.
retry_policy: Allow retries after feedback; platform-wide XP rules determine any reward. This exercise defines no XP override.
